content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates must have a graduation or postgraduate degree with at least 60% marks in any discipline. The qualification must have been completed through the regular stream from a recognised university. For the Manager rank, candidates need at least three years of relevant banking experience. For the Assistant Manager rank, candidates need at least two years of relevant banking experience. The relevant experience should be in sourcing or processing loans, MSME loans or retail loans. No vigilance case or adverse observation from RBI or another statutory authority should be pending. Candidates must possess a graduate or postgraduate degree from a recognised university under the regular curriculum. Applicants need at least five years of experience in sourcing or processing loans or MSME loans. Out of the required experience, at least three years must have been completed as a Relationship Manager. No vigilance case or adverse observation from the disciplinary authority, vigilance authority, RBI or another statutory authority should be pending.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for any of the advertised posts.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The TMB selection process will involve the following stages: Scrutiny of online applications Shortlisting based on eligibility, qualification and experience Personal interview Final selection by the bank The interview for Relationship Manager and Senior Relationship Manager may be conducted directly or through video conferencing. The interview date, time and mode will be communicated individually to shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: Post-Wise Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Acquire new customers and maintain existing customer relationships. Promote CASA, loans, insurance, investment products and other banking services. Achieve assigned sales and business targets. Cross-sell banking and third-party products. Ensure KYC compliance and proper documentation. Conduct customer meetings, field visits and collateral verification where required. Assess customer background and credit risk. Support customer retention, portfolio management and recovery follow-up. Identify clients with substantial credit requirements. Develop relationships with existing high-value customers. Cross-sell and upsell credit products and banking services. Achieve revenue and high-value business targets. Manage the allotted credit portfolio and maintain asset quality. Negotiate credit terms, interest rates and loan agreements. Prepare account-performance, sales-activity and market-insight reports. Participate in industry events and professional networking activities.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep scanned copies of the following documents ready: SSLC or Higher Secondary marksheet/transfer certificate as proof of age Degree and other educational certificates Experience certificates Relieving letters from previous employers Latest monthly salary slip Recent photograph Signature The preferred photograph dimensions are 390 × 520 pixels with a maximum file size of 120 KB. The preferred signature dimensions are 240 × 240 pixels with a maximum file size of 60 KB. Signatures written in capital letters will not be accepted. Each supporting document should generally not exceed 250 KB.

faq.question: Q1. Which posts are covered under TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment covers Relationship Manager and Senior Relationship Manager posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Relationship Manager post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 7 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The application fee is nil for all posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age for Relationship Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be older than 35 years as on 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for a personal interview.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply online through the official Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Careers portal.
